title: Pagamentos - api-assinaturas
description: Eventos simulados. Contadores medem etapas e linhas; ausencia de eventos nao comprova disponibilidade. Filtro request_id aceita regex.

panels.title: Eventos no periodo
panels.description: Quantidade de linhas de log; nao representa operacoes unicas.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="log-generator"} | json service="service", environment="environment", request_id="request_id", level="level", event="event", status="status", error_type="error_type", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | service="api-assinaturas" | environment=~"${environment:raw}" | request_id=~"${request_id:raw}" | drop request_id, duration_ms [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Etapas concluidas com sucesso
panels.description: Conclusoes desta etapa, sem contar retries ou encerramentos do fluxo.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="log-generator"} | json service="service", environment="environment", request_id="request_id", level="level", event="event", status="status", error_type="error_type", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | service="api-assinaturas" | environment=~"${environment:raw}" | request_id=~"${request_id:raw}" | drop request_id, duration_ms | event="subscription.finished" | status="success" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Etapas encerradas com falha
panels.description: Falhas definitivas desta etapa. Falha posterior em outro servico nao altera esta contagem.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="log-generator"} | json service="service", environment="environment", request_id="request_id", level="level", event="event", status="status", error_type="error_type", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | service="api-assinaturas" | environment=~"${environment:raw}" | request_id=~"${request_id:raw}" | drop request_id, duration_ms | event="subscription.finished" | status="error" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Linhas ERROR
panels.description: Inclui erros recuperaveis e mensagens de encerramento; um incidente pode gerar varias linhas.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="log-generator"} | json service="service", environment="environment", request_id="request_id", level="level", event="event", status="status", error_type="error_type", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | service="api-assinaturas" | environment=~"${environment:raw}" | request_id=~"${request_id:raw}" | drop request_id, duration_ms | level="ERROR" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum by (level) (count_over_time({service_name="log-generator"} | json service="service", environment="environment", request_id="request_id", level="level", event="event", status="status", error_type="error_type", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | service="api-assinaturas" | environment=~"${environment:raw}" | request_id=~"${request_id:raw}" | drop request_id, duration_ms [1m]))

panels.title: Conclusoes da etapa por status / minuto

targets.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({service_name="log-generator"} | json service="service", environment="environment", request_id="request_id", level="level", event="event", status="status", error_type="error_type", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | service="api-assinaturas" | environment=~"${environment:raw}" | request_id=~"${request_id:raw}" | drop request_id, duration_ms | event="subscription.finished" [1m]))

panels.title: Duracao media da etapa / minuto
panels.description: Duracao simulada medida no gerador; inclui tentativas e esperas na etapa de pagamento. Sem dados permanece vazio.

targets.expr: avg by (status) (avg_over_time({service_name="log-generator"} | json service="service", environment="environment", request_id="request_id", level="level", event="event", status="status", error_type="error_type", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | service="api-assinaturas" | environment=~"${environment:raw}" | request_id=~"${request_id:raw}" | event="subscription.finished" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [1m]))

sum by (error_type) (count_over_time({service_name="log-generator"} | json service="service", environment="environment", request_id="request_id", level="level", event="event", status="status", error_type="error_type", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | service="api-assinaturas" | environment=~"${environment:raw}" | request_id=~"${request_id:raw}" | drop request_id, duration_ms | event="subscription.finished" | status="error" [1m]))

panels.title: Logs do servico - correlacao por request_id
panels.description: Filtro request_id aceita expressao regular; .* mostra todas as operacoes.
